class.name: CbViewCamera
class.brief_description: Where the viewer's eye is while an item is held in first person: a camera to look through in the editor.
class.description: Put one in an item's scene and name it in the [CbItem]'s [member CbItem.view_camera]. Select it and tick Preview (top left of the 3D view): that is what the holder sees, with the game's field of view when [member Camera3D.fov] is the game's (60). Move and turn it until the item sits right; an item usually comes out of a lower corner and points at the middle of the picture. In the game it is a place only. The place is baked with the item, and the node takes itself out of the scene: no look can make the game look through it.
